title: Publish a spreadsheet through a protected API
description: Generate the maintained local spreadsheet scaffold, verify its protected Relay surface, and identify which files become human-owned after generation.
outcome: A synthetic spreadsheet is available through a purpose-limited Relay API, with anonymous and under-scoped requests denied.
prerequisites: A Main-source registryctl binary and image lock built from one recorded commit
A Docker Compose provider
curl

minimal_configuration.note: The embedded spreadsheet starter is the complete maintained authored project. The workbook remains a synthetic fixture; review all authored files before building or starting the local runtime.

artifacts.note: Human-owned registry intent, service purpose, scopes, and disclosure projection.
Human-owned strict spreadsheet schema and materialization bounds.
Operator-owned local workbook binding, source generation, and local caller setup.
The generated workbook contains synthetic tutorial records only.
Registryctl-owned deterministic unsigned Relay input and artifact manifest.
Registryctl-owned private local credentials and closed Compose runtime material.

expected_trace: Registryctl initializes the embedded synthetic workbook and complete authored project.
Preflight, check, and build validate the strict spreadsheet binding and compile the Relay input.
Doctor and start prepare the isolated local runtime after the authored and generated surfaces are reviewed.
Smoke exercises maintained local allowed and denied requests without publishing credentials.

proves: The embedded starter compiles one local Relay over synthetic tabular data.
Protected metadata and record operations enforce configured caller, scope, purpose, and field-release boundaries.
Authored, generated build, and generated runtime surfaces have distinct ownership.
does_not_prove: Compatibility with a country spreadsheet, database, identity provider, or network.
Production key custody, policy approval, legal approval, or operational resilience.
That generated local credentials are suitable outside this disposable journey.

review: Inspect registry-stack.yaml, entities/projects.yaml, and environments/local.yaml before first build.
Confirm the synthetic workbook and generated runtime material are not substituted for country data or production credentials.
Inspect .registry-stack/build/local and .registry-stack/runtime/local as generated output, not as authored configuration or production acceptance.

gates.name: Registryctl doctor
gates.proves: The local scaffold, runtime files, and selected local posture pass the product checks reached by doctor.
gates.does_not_prove: Source accuracy, production readiness, or approval of generated credentials.

gates.name: Relay startup validation
gates.proves: Relay accepted the strict configuration and reached the configured local listener.
gates.does_not_prove: The configuration is authorized for a production environment.

gates.name: Registryctl smoke
gates.proves: Maintained synthetic allowed and denied requests behaved as expected against the local runtime.
gates.does_not_prove: Live-source interoperability, load behavior, disaster recovery, or external acceptance.

production_delta.secrets: Provision credentials and trust material through operator-managed references.
production_delta.approval: Record country-author, product-owner, and operator approval for the reviewed candidate.
production_delta.signing: Sign each immutable product input with the authorized product-specific identity.

troubleshooting.meaning: A Relay configuration or metadata document does not match its required syntax or typed schema.
troubleshooting.remediation: Compare the authored input with the current Relay schema, run authored-project validation when generated, correct the document, regenerate generated Relay input, then retry.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category does not disclose parser excerpts, field paths, local paths, or supplied values. It does not claim field-level diagnostics were emitted.

troubleshooting.meaning: The parsed Relay configuration failed product validation.
troubleshooting.remediation: Run the authored-project validator, correct its field-addressed issues and governed bindings, regenerate the Relay input, then retry.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category does not disclose configured identifiers, URLs, environment names, hashes, or source values.

troubleshooting.meaning: Relay could not open the configured data-plane listener.
troubleshooting.remediation: Check interface availability, address-family support, and deployment networking for server.bind in its owning input; regenerate generated Relay input, then retry.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The fallback category names server.bind but does not disclose its address, port, or operating-system error.

troubleshooting.meaning: Relay doctor found one or more blocking diagnostics.
troubleshooting.remediation: Use the static diagnostic codes and actions in the doctor report.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The process failure does not repeat diagnostic source values or report internals.

troubleshooting.meaning: A required secret reference is unavailable to this process.
troubleshooting.remediation: Provide the secret to the process environment.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: Preflight does not contact live sources or prove remote availability.

troubleshooting.meaning: Bundle authenticity or declared content integrity verification failed.
troubleshooting.remediation: Rebuild and sign the complete bundle with an accepted trust configuration.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category does not disclose signer identifiers, file names, or content digests.

troubleshooting.meaning: The bundle binding does not match the intended runtime target.
troubleshooting.remediation: Use a bundle issued for the intended runtime binding.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category does not disclose received or configured binding values.

troubleshooting.meaning: The bundle or override does not satisfy local anti-rollback requirements.
troubleshooting.remediation: Use a monotonic bundle or an authorized break-glass selection.
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category does not disclose stored sequences, content digests, paths, or approval values.

troubleshooting.meaning: Registry Notary runtime activation is required before serving
troubleshooting.remediation: run the compiled Registry Notary runtime activation step before building or serving routers
troubleshooting.evidence_limitation: The category confirms only the failed activation boundary; it does not disclose paths, URLs, hashes, credentials, identifiers, parser text, authored values, source responses, or country values.

configuration_files.content:
integrations:
  person-record:
    file: integrations/person-record/integration.yaml
registry:
  id: fictional-citizen-registry
services:
  person-verification:
    access:
      scopes:
        - evidence:person:read
    claims:
      person-active:
        disclosure: value
        output: person_record.active
      person-record-exists:
        cel: person_record.matched
        disclosure: predicate
    consent: not_required
    consultations:
      person_record:
        input:
          person_id: request.target.identifiers.registry_person_id
        integration: person-record
    credential_profiles:
      person-status:
        claims:
          - person-record-exists
          - person-active
        format: dc+sd-jwt
        type: https://credentials.invalid/person-status/v1
        validity: 10m
    kind: evidence
    legal_basis: public-service-delivery
    purpose: public-service-person-verification
    version: 1
starter:
  content_digest: sha256:a4e0263957f3dd7756ef1a270483f4aa5f856102f070c6e0325e8cc9b1413b76
  id: http
  release: 0.15.0
version: 1

callers:
  evidence-client:
    api_key_fingerprint:
      secret: EVIDENCE_CLIENT_TOKEN_HASH
    scopes:
      - evidence:person:read
deployment:
  notary:
    service: fictional-registry-notary
  profile: local
  relay:
    service: fictional-registry-relay
integrations:
  person-record:
    source:
      credential:
        generation: 1
        token:
          secret: FICTIONAL_REGISTRY_TOKEN
      origin: https://citizen-registry.invalid
issuance:
  generation: 1
  issuer: did:web:notary.invalid
  signing_key:
    secret: REGISTRY_NOTARY_ISSUER_JWK
  signing_kid: project-issuer-key
notary_relay:
  base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8080
  token_file: /run/secrets/relay-workload-token
  workload_client_id: fictional-registry-notary
relay:
  allowed_clients:
    - fictional-relay-client
  audience: registry-relay
  issuer: https://workload-issuer.internal.invalid
  jwks_url: https://workload-issuer.internal.invalid/.well-known/jwks.json
  origin: https://relay.internal.invalid
version: 1

capability:
  http:
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /people/{input.person_id}
      query:
        fields: active
    response:
      ambiguous:
        - 409
      no_match:
        - 404
id: person-record
input:
  person_id:
    maxLength: 64
    role: selector
    type: string
not_applicable:
  subject_mismatch:
    rationale: The selected response projection contains no identifier that can be compared with the requested person identifier.
    request_fixture: active-person
outputs:
  active:
    type: boolean
    x-registry-source: /active
revision: 1
source:
  auth:
    type: static_bearer
  product: replace-with-source-product
  versions:
    unverified:
      - replace-with-source-version
version: 1

fixture_excerpt.content:
classification: synthetic
expect:
  claims:
    person-active: true
    person-record-exists: true
  outcome: match
  outputs:
    active: true
input:
  person_id: AB-123456
interactions:
  - expect:
      method: GET
      path: /people/AB-123456
      query:
        fields: active
    respond:
      body:
        active: true
      status: 200
name: active-person
request:
  claims:
    - person-record-exists
  disclosure: predicate
  format: application/vnd.registry-notary.claim-result+json
  purpose: public-service-person-verification
  target:
    identifiers:
      - scheme: registry_person_id
        value: AB-123456
    type: Person

steps.label: Optional watch loop
steps.note: This long-running alternative reruns the focused synthetic fixture after authored files change. It is not part of the required noninteractive sequence.

steps.label: Compare authored semantics with the embedded starter
Inspect missing offline requirements before operator handoff
steps.note: This clean-workspace step is expected to exit 1 with a value-free not_ready report because operator-provisioned runtime files and secret references are absent. It proves the diagnostic boundary, not readiness. Provision the reviewed environment bindings, rerun this command, and require a passing report before signing, verification, promotion, or activation handoff.

steps.label: Review against governed product baselines
inputs: Separately verified Relay baseline bundle and Relay trust anchor
Separately verified Notary baseline bundle and Notary trust anchor
outputs: Value-safe promotion report and required-action review
steps.procedure: Only after operators supply both product-owned baseline paths and trust anchors, use the registryctl promote lifecycle interface for the fixed project directory and local environment. This governed review is separate from the first-time starter comparison and does not authorize activation.

steps.label: Sign and verify the Relay product input
inputs: Operator-selected Relay trust anchor and anti-rollback sequence
steps.procedure: Use registryctl bundle sign with --out journey-output/registry-relay-bundle, then verify that directory with the product-owned Relay trust anchor. Signing material is never rendered into a shell block.

steps.label: Sign and verify the Notary product input
inputs: Operator-selected Notary trust anchor and anti-rollback sequence
steps.procedure: Use registryctl bundle sign with --out journey-output/registry-notary-bundle, then verify that directory with the product-owned Notary trust anchor. This does not claim product activation.
